headline: Bejeweled
title: Bejeweled Facts | From Diamond Mine To Hall Of Fame | Classic Games
video_script: Bejeweled started in two thousand as a browser game called Diamond Mine by the team that became PopCap Games. It was renamed Bejeweled when it went onto MSN Games. Swapping gems to match three of a kind popularized the match three style. In twenty twenty, The Strong National Museum of Play inducted it into the World Video Game Hall of Fame. Which match three game is your favorite? Comment below!

scenes.sub: World Video Game Hall of Fame

description: Bejeweled began as Diamond Mine by PopCap Games and was inducted into the World Video Game Hall of Fame in 2020. Sources: Wikipedia, The Strong National Museum of Play.
joke: One more match and then I stop, said everyone, forever.
